test_title: PYST 15: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

Don’t forget __post__ these letters.
solution: The correct answer is '**to post**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is grammatically incorrect. • Here, '**to post**' should be used instead of '**post**'. • The given sentence is an example of **an imperative sentence.** • The structure of this sentence is: **Intransitive Verb + to-infinitive, Transitive verb.** • Here, '**forget**' means **'to not remember to do something'.** • *Example: Don't forget **to lock** the door.* • Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4**.** Correct Sentence:__** *Don't forget __**to post**__ these letters.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है। • यहां '**post**' के स्थान पर '**to post**' का प्रयोग करना चाहिए। • दिया गया वाक्य **imperative sentence** का उदाहरण है। • इस वाक्य की संरचना है : Intransitive Verb + to-infinitive, Transitive verb। • यहाँ '**forget**' का अर्थ है** 'भूल जाना'**। • *Example: Don't forget** to lock** the door.* • अत: सही उत्तर **विकल्प 4** है। 3b:Tcc9, The erroneous part is **'not stay out'.**
